description: View or customize a server's sandbox capability manifest (env/network/filesystem/subprocess access). Use action 'view' to inspect, 'set' to tighten or loosen grants (applies on next connect), or 'reset' to revert to defaults.

action.description: view = inspect manifest; set = override grants; reset = revert to defaults

envAllow.description: [set] Environment variable NAMES the server may receive, e.g. ['GITHUB_TOKEN']

fsRead.description: [set] Absolute paths the server may read

fsWrite.description: [set] Absolute paths the server may write

network.description: [set] Network mode. 'none' = no network, 'allowlist' = only listed hosts, 'all' = unrestricted

networkAllow.description: [set] Allowed host:port patterns for allowlist mode, e.g. ['api.github.com:443', '*.example.com']

slug.description: Server slug (as shown by mcp_list_active or mcp_discover)

subprocess.description: [set] Whether the server may spawn subprocesses

name: mcp_sandbox
